plan.title: Publish RFQ with no terms and conditions

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Switch the default event type to RFQ and use whole-lot awarding.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet can be configured.
Add the specified product and quantity.
Set the requested delivery location in the pricing sheet.

args.goal: On the buyer's single-stage create screen, open the Terms and Conditions controls, remove every clause, complete the modal with Done, and stop when the screen proves that no terms or clauses remain

steps.note: Remove all clauses, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Add one QA test vendor so the event can be published and its vendor view checked.
Publish the RFQ and confirm the publish dialog.
Verify that a real published project page was reached.

args.text: Terms and conditions are not added

steps.note: Check the published project warning about missing terms and conditions.
Open the invited QA vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the published event's RFQ pricing view as the vendor.
Verify that the vendor's pricing view has no T&C block.
